text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we still have some time before 
practice starts...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Shall we put on a fruit face pack 
before we head out?♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, as a princess, skincare must be 
done elegantly~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhhhーーー!! Royal Princess Hand 
Place-!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ There really is nothing quite like 
crushing a pineapple, rind and all, with 
your bare hands!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We are far from done! Grate it even finer! 
Let all those skin-beautifying nutrients 
seep out~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Take thiiiiiis! Royal Princess Hand 
Craaaash!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! How clumsy of me! I've spilled 
everything everywhere~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kh! A princess never gives up! I still 
have plenty of pineapples left!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gyaah! Now juice got in my eyes! One more 
time, please!

And so, before she knew it, practice time 
had passed, and Kawakami Princess ended up 
ditching her training...
